acceptance: A fresh local run with translation (e.g. `benchbox run --platform sqlite --benchmark tpch --scale 0.01`, or datafusion) produces a bundle whose execution.translation.runtime equals benchbox/_vendor/sqlglot.json (version, fork_sha, upstream_sha, and sha256 as wheel_sha256); command and extracted keys recorded in the PR body.
A DataFrame run and a run with no translation outcomes carry no runtime object (execution.translation absent or without runtime); a test covers a DataFrame run.

validate_submission --require-manifest, results-data/validate_corpus.py and the public-export/benchbox-submit anonymisation keep the fields unchanged and pass leak checks; a test proves submit/export output still contains runtime.version and fork_sha unaltered.
bundle.py rejects a malformed runtime object (wrong types, missing version) with a clear error; an absent object is accepted for old bundles.
Tests catch regressions: the field equals the vendored runtime pin; old bundles without it still load and validate; result_schema_version unchanged.
PR merged via make pr-open (local oracle SHIP, no override) and make pr-arm; changelog fragment added.
context: DECISION GATE: if recording the runtime requires a schema version bump or per-query records, STOP and ask the owner (out of scope).
description:
Result bundles record the BenchBox, engine and driver versions but not the bundled SQLGlot runtime that translated the SQL (benchbox/_vendor/sqlglot.json: version, fork_sha, upstream_sha, sha256). All 58 bundles ingested by #3678 record BenchBox 0.5.0rc1 although they ran on two different wheels, so users cannot tell which translation produced a result. Owner decision 2026-10-28: record translator identity only (no per-query SQL hashes).

DESIGN (research and review against origin/develop 4ee345105; re-verify before implementing): SQLGlot is imported only as benchbox._vendor.sqlglot and benchbox/_vendor/__init__.py (~:5-13) selects the archive from the pin, so the pin names the runtime that loads. Read it from `benchbox._vendor._runtime_pin` and add `execution.translation.runtime` = {distribution, version, fork_sha, upstream_sha, wheel_sha256 (renamed from the pin's sha256)}; omit the pin's schema, namespace, wheel, archive and repository keys. Build it where the translation summary is built (summarize_sql_translation_outcomes; schema.py ~:923-925 `execution.translation`, filled at runner.py ~:427-439). execution.translation exists only when translation ran (dialect_utils.py ~:133-134 returns None without outcomes), so DataFrame and no-translation runs carry no runtime object. The loader already passes execution.translation through (loader.py ~:315). Nested additive field: no schema version bump (precedents data_generation_hash #2304, execution_class #3618; schema validator strict only on top-level keys, schema.py ~:196-198). benchbox/validation/bundle.py type-checks the object when present. Absent means 'not recorded'; never infer it. Known limit to state in the PR and docs: SQLGlot also changes SQL in paths that do not log translation outcomes (read-primitives variant contracts, TPC-DS qualification); such runs show no runtime.

GUARDRAILS: no schema version bump; no per-query fields (need schema 2.5; out of scope by owner decision); key names must not be rewritten by the anonymiser (check anonymization_specs.yaml identifier/endpoint/path keys and _identifier_prefix_for_key_tail, which also rewrites names ending in bucket, arn, endpoint, directory, folder, executable, file, path, root, dir, prefix, url, host, or named engine/schema); public export and benchbox submit keep the fields and leak checks pass; published bundle JSON is never modified.
